posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md: Does anyone in this group know anything about the Lambdapro dpss lasers? Do they have enough coherence for long enough time for holography? The prices look good.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:

Ahh, wouldn't 1W be nice?

Where did you find their prices? I couldn't find any on their web site.

posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md:
I asked the distributor for Lambdapro, who also has some for auction on eBay about the coherence length of the UGA-250. He said:

> The coherence length is about 3 cm (typical for a DPSS laser), so it is typically unsuitable for applications such as holography.

Too bad. Funny, the Lambdapro website has a 1 Watt green laser and lists among the applications "Laser holography".

[http://www.lambdapro.com/product.htm](http://www.lambdapro.com/product.htm)
